slots.hypothesis: Uncertainty about risk, measured without the scale of volatility (de-scaled realized vol-of-vol), direction expected -1. Head 3 ts_sum(cross_stddev(day_std(Ret), 60), 1) is the un-scaled version and has |rho| 0.56 with the vol control. The r2 R group already showed the 60-day CV scores +1.04 / +1.11 with vol 0.18, but that CV would hit the 0.7 library ban against head 3. So the 15 seeds use forms head 3 cannot build: std / mean-abs / median-abs of daily and weekly dlog(sigma), cross_semistd_pos/neg on day_std(Ret), the 20-day CV of three vol estimators (day_std, intraday range, turnover-weighted day_wstd), the 20-day std of cs_demean(log sigma), the autocorrelation of log sigma, and the CV of intraday 30-minute rolling vol. Two cs_bucket_rank hedges rank within vol deciles and within liquidity deciles. Sources: Baltussen et al. 2018, Andersen-Bollerslev-Diebold-Labys 2003, Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard 2002, Bollerslev-Li-Zhao 2020.

Uncertainty about liquidity: how much daily trading activity varies across days relative to its own mean, direction expected -1 (Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Anshuman 2001; Pereira-Zhang 2010). The A-share mechanism is retail speculation and attention bursts under short-sale limits (Mei-Scheinkman-Xiong 2009; Barber-Odean 2008). The 14 seeds use the 20/60/120-day CV of day_sum(Volume) and day_sum(Amt), log-space std, std and mean-abs of dlog(volume), cross_semistd_pos/neg (spikes vs droughts), a max/median spike ratio, and the CV of day_std(Ret)/day_sum(Amt). Hedges: CV ranked within liquidity deciles and within LogFloatCap deciles, and a cs_regres of volume CV on sigma CV to separate it from slot a. This is cross-day and scale-free, and it avoids the 1/var(x) pole of the 14 cross_regbeta heads.

result.summary:
I wrote the seed 807 round-3 plan as two N slots, no E slot, plus 9 R variants. The last run of scripts/c06_check.py 807 3 printed ADMISSIBLE, exit 0. No correlation table or audit has run on it yet.

**Why no E slot.** The structure anatomist recommended an E slot on day_distinct_ratio(Volume). I left it out for three reasons:
- **Likely blocked by a control:** that core grows mechanically with shares traded per minute, so it is probably a nonlinear liquidity/price proxy. I put the chance that its |rho| with a control is 0.5 or more at about 0.55, which would block it under rule §3.
- **It would add more of the same family:** an E slot has no family control, so the GP would likely regrow the cross_regbeta / inv / mask ratio structures. That family is already 14 of the 24 heads, and 10 of them are higher on train than on valid.
- **The other cores are ruled out:** the last E credit on the W² core would only find volatility scale again. The DW and head-3 cores have |rho| of 0.5 or more with the vol control, so §3 blocks them.

The rule of at least one passing N slot over 3 rounds was already met.

**Slot a (N, 15 seeds): de-scaled vol-of-vol.** This is the only source in this seed that survived removing volatility scale: the 60-day CV of daily sigma scored +1.04 / +1.11 with |rho| 0.18 against the vol control. That CV itself would hit the 0.7 ban against head 3, so the seeds use other forms (log-vol changes, up/down split, persistence, intraday, 20-day CV of other vol estimators).

**Slot b (N, 14 seeds): variability of trading activity across days.** It follows Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Anshuman 2001 and Pereira-Zhang 2010, with hedges inside liquidity and size deciles and a residual on sigma CV to keep it apart from slot a.

**R, 9 variants in 5 groups:**
- **Head +1.199:** a cross_corr swap and an Amt-only x leg.
- **Head +1.215:** cs_winsor on the inv pole, a cross_corr swap, and an Amt x leg.
- **Head +1.094:** the Amt version already measured at +1.371, labelled in the plan as a known number meant to trigger replacement.
- **Head 3:** two log de-scaled variants.
- **The F4 price head:** a bare-price check.

I dropped the anatomist's cross_cov and swapped-regression variants: if either won, it would bring a liquidity-scaled factor into the library.

**Notebook.** The 第 3 轮 section is appended to /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/research/coldstart_C06/partura/s807/notebook.md. It covers current beliefs, the reasons for N+N, prior predictions for each slot and each R group (slot a about 0.55 to produce a head, slot b about 0.40, total replacements or additions at most 2 with 0.8), and a grading table for the r2 predictions.

I checked four citations with web search (Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Anshuman 2001, Pereira-Zhang 2010, Mei-Scheinkman-Xiong 2009, and the 2018 paper's PDF link); the rest come from lit.md or are standard papers.
